$comment: Observed client-side error codes and their real causes. Source: Game.log + capstone parser analysis.

errors.cause: AGS_IDENTITY_REQUIRED — but semantically it is 0xcb = JSON PARSE ERROR of the aws-sdk
errors.note: Any missing/typo'd key in the token response produces 203. NOT a semantic code.

errors.cause: credentials parser: PascalCase keys or ISO expiration. Parser reads camelCase with a lookup returning NULL if missing; caller dereferences. expiration must be double epoch.

RESOLVED 2026-09-14: panel needs LoginInfoList as OBJECT with PascalCase Worlds+Characters; Characters empty = panel empty even with correct worlds; lowercase worlds list rejects extra keys. Server fix in routes/registry.py getlogininfo_doc (dual schema).

client pins an EMBEDDED CN=New World cert — no CA we control can validate. Handshake only completes with the in-memory verify-bypass (scripts/frida-trust-patch.py, site 0x145dce8b5 VERIFIED byte-identical on our build). Verified: real client completed DTLS vs our server 2026-09-14 with the patch active.

errors.code: ERROR DE CONEXIÓN / No se pudo conectar con una sesión
errors.cause: client looped CONNECT_REQUEST (system channel 3, msgId last byte, payload [u32 BE len][cookie]) for ~30s without a valid CONNECT_ACK then gives up. Our echo-ACK shape not yet accepted — open as of 2026-09-14.
errors.note: live capture with raw hex in services/world/rep_traffic.jsonl

errors.cause: No error for unknown fields — but wrong TYPE on a known field fails the parse. EXCEPTION (proven 2026-09-14): the lowercase worlds dropdown model DROPS THE OBJECT on extra keys — treat that one as strict.
